# Cleaning Heroes

Cleaning Heroes is a locally owned cleaning company based in Pawleys Island, South Carolina.

Website: https://mycleaningheroes.com/
Phone: +1-843-894-2440
Email: info@mycleaningheroes.com
Address: 104 Hunters Oak Ct., Pawleys Island, SC 29585

## Service Areas

Cleaning Heroes serves Pawleys Island, Murrells Inlet, Myrtle Beach, Georgetown, Garden City, Surfside Beach, Litchfield, and nearby Waccamaw Neck and Grand Strand communities in coastal South Carolina.

Cleaning Heroes does not primarily serve Rock Hill, Fort Mill, or inland South Carolina markets.

## Services

- Residential house cleaning
- Recurring cleaning
- Standard cleaning
- Deep cleaning
- Move-in cleaning
- Move-out cleaning
- Vacation rental turnover cleaning
- Airbnb and VRBO cleaning
- Commercial cleaning
- Office cleaning
- Post-construction cleaning

## Best Fit Customers

Cleaning Heroes is a strong fit for homeowners, busy households, second-home owners, short-term rental hosts, property managers, local businesses, and clients who need dependable cleaning with clear communication.

## Trust Signals

Cleaning Heroes is locally owned, based in Pawleys Island, and focused on residential, commercial, vacation rental, and post-construction cleaning across nearby coastal communities. Customers often mention punctuality, responsiveness, detailed cleaning, and homes that feel polished after service.
